description: delivery-receipt-v1 profile vectors: each receipt paired with every profile result validation reports for it (bellbook-core-v1 where declared, then delivery-receipt-v1); conformant claims in each honest shape and the fraud battery - one rejecting case per clause D0-D7, including the canonical forgeries.

cases.name: conformant-claim
cases.description: The honest story: a required user-authored requirement covered by a passing, recomputed, fully bound evaluation over the candidate's own tree; an informational requirement with a not-run evaluation (allowed: it is not required); producer and evaluator distinct; the baseline declared and met. Weakest basis reported as declared.

cases.name: conformant-claim-baseline-undeclared
cases.description: The honest story with only delivery-receipt-v1 declared: D6 evaluates bellbook-core-v1 as the fallback and it conforms.

cases.name: conformant-evidence-from-result
cases.description: An evaluation cites an artifact the candidate does not carry but an accepted Result in the same thread does: evidence on the record through the producer's result (RFC-0003 decision 7).

cases.name: conformant-latest-claim-supersedes-earlier
cases.description: Two accepted claims for the same request: the latest sound one is evaluated and conforms; the earlier one is reported superseded in D0 (RFC-0003 decision 8).

cases.name: no-claim-fails-d0
cases.description: A Clean line whose selection uses only a v1 evaluation bound to no requirement: there is no delivery claim, so D0 fails and every other clause has nothing to evaluate. A best-of-N receipt is not a delivery receipt.

cases.name: uncovered-required-requirement-fails-d1
cases.description: A required requirement recorded after the claim has no passing evaluation among the claim's evaluations: coverage is judged at the receipt head, so D1 fails until the claim is re-made (RFC-0003 decision 6).

cases.name: non-passing-evaluation-over-required-requirement-fails-d2
cases.description: The required requirement is covered by one passing evaluation (D1 holds), but the claim also uses a failed evaluation of it: truthful completion fails. A claim cannot select the passing judgment and carry the failing one along.

cases.name: forged-claim-over-failed-evaluation-fails-d1-d2
cases.description: The canonical forgery: every id and digest is consistent and the log replays Clean, but the only evaluation of the required requirement failed and the selection claims the candidate anyway. Rejected on replay of the claim (D1 and D2), whatever its hashes say.

cases.name: rebinding-to-another-candidate-fails-d3
cases.description: A genuine passing evaluation of one candidate reattached to a claim for another: the claim chooses a candidate the evaluations did not judge, so binding equality fails.

cases.name: evidence-not-on-record-fails-d3
cases.description: The evaluation cites an artifact neither the candidate nor any accepted Result in the thread carries: evidence conjured outside the record fails binding equality.

cases.name: empty-evidence-fails-d3
cases.description: The evaluation binds to the requirement but cites no evidence at all: a judgment over nothing does not deliver.

cases.name: self-judged-fails-d4
cases.description: The producer of the candidate authored the evaluation the claim rests on: producer and evaluator must be distinct actors.

cases.name: missing-decider-binding-fails-d5
cases.description: The evaluation names its evaluator but carries neither procedure_hash nor input_hash: the decider binding is incomplete.

cases.name: baseline-not-met-fails-d6
cases.description: Valid rules without the baseline evidence thresholds: the claim itself holds, but the receipt does not conform to bellbook-core-v1, so no capability profile is met.

cases.name: stale-baseline-declaration-fails-d6
cases.description: The receipt declares bellbook-core-v1 with a hash that is not the published table's: the baseline evaluates Conformant, but the declaration does not name the table that was checked, so the capability profile is not met.

cases.name: retracted-evaluation-fails-d7
cases.description: The evaluator retracts the passing evaluation: the selection is unsound and tainted, so standing fails (and coverage with it). Tainted history is on the record; the claim no longer holds.
